blocker.message: Your account has exceeded D1's free tier daily row write limit. Upgrade to a paid plan or wait until tomorrow (midnight UTC) to continue.

failurePoint.interpretation: The failure occurred while persisting D1 progress metadata after cold-pack work had started. This is an infrastructure quota stop, not evidence of source-data corruption or System1 contamination.

resumeSafety.safeActionAfterReset: Fresh-dispatch 2021 TPEX on latest main; do not delete or rewrite partial cold history.

nextAction: Wait for free-tier D1 daily write quota reset, then fresh-dispatch 2021 TPEX from latest main and complete physical verification.
